items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: The fellow that died, his brother's a saxophone player here now. He studied with me. ... Oh, Walt Lavinsky? ... Yeah, well, his brother Kermit Lavinsky. He studied with me

ctx.x: I was teaching clarinet and composition. And I had some good students like Bill Verplank (PHONETIC), he started with me. And several others. The fellow that died, his brother's a saxophone player here now. He studied with me. What was the saxophone player, the red fellow, that

Yeah, well, his brother Kermit Lavinsky. He studied with me and he was a fine tenor player. But he studied composition with me and he finally ended up in Hollywood writing for movies and pictures and everything. But he committed suicide a few years ago.
